svg.title: The title intro's four planes
svg.desc: The title intro after the prologue pulled apart into the four planes the console stacks to draw it, numbered from back to front. 1, BG1: the purple clouds. 2, BG2: the blue sky and clouds. 3, BG0: the mountain. 4, the sprites: the sun on its patch of blue sky and the lens flares below it. BG1 and BG2 scroll at different speeds, so the sky seems deep.
svg.text: THE TITLE INTRO, PULLED APART: BACK TO FRONT
the sun and its lens flares
BG1 and BG2 scroll at different speeds,
